about: PixelLab provenance for the hd64 bow/crossbow icon judging mock (2026-10-24 brief, run 2026-10-23). Raw outputs in raw/, cleaned keepers in hd64/.

shared_params.palette: hr-world-56-v2 (art/world/palette.json, all 56 colours passed as the palette)
shared_params.style_image: upload of art/world/sandbox64/sandbox_barrel.png (32x63, the sandbox's own s1 Pro Flash art)
shared_params.style_usage: Copy only how this barrel is rendered: its wood-grain texture, shading tones, single dark outline and colours. Do not copy its shape or its size; the new item is drawn bigger.
shared_params.prompt_tail_bows: No arrow, no stock, no crossbow parts. The bow is drawn big and lies on the diagonal from the top-right corner to the bottom-left corner, filling most of the canvas. Clean shading in a few tones per material, visible wood grain, single dark outline, lit from the upper left, no background, no shadow, classic MMORPG item icon.
shared_params.prompt_tail_crossbows: Clearly a crossbow with a stock. No arrow loaded. Drawn big, filling most of the canvas. Clean shading in a few tones per material, visible wood grain, single dark outline, lit from the upper left, no background, no shadow, classic MMORPG item icon.
